core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Luxury Fintech (Gold/Purple) with EdTech (Clean/White).
Emotion First: The dashboard should feel 'Lucrative' and 'Progressive'.
Content is King: Data (Earnings) is the hero. Make numbers big and beautiful.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to separate 'Earning' areas from 'Learning' areas.
anti_patterns: No default Shadcn cards (must have custom shadows).
No clutter (hide low-priority actions in dropdowns).

usage_rules: Use 'Manrope' specifically for all currency and commission percentage values.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for Page Titles and Section Headers.
Use 'Inter' for long-form text and instructions.

contrast_rules: Header text must be Pure White (#FFFFFF) or Light Grey (#CBD5E1) against the dark header.
Card text must be Slate-900 (#0F172A) for readability.
Commission values should use the 'Secondary' (Gold/Amber) color to signify wealth.

header_banner.content_alignment: flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center pt-10 pb-20
header_banner.decorations: Use abstract geometric overlays (opacity-20) in the background.

cards.base: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300
cards.referral_card: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-6 rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium py-2 px-6 rounded-full transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white font-bold py-2 px-6 rounded-full shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 text-base transition-all

tabs.trigger: rounded-full px-6 py-2 data-[state=active]:bg-white data-[state=active]:text-indigo-600 data-[state=active]:shadow-sm transition-all

usage.header: Use 'header_bg' with an absolute positioned div, z-0, opacity-30, mix-blend-overlay.
usage.avatars: Use UI Avatars (api.dicebear.com) or initials for user profiles if no image is uploaded.

presets.card_entrance: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut' }}
presets.number_count: Use 'react-countup' or similar for earnings numbers.

checklist: Ensure text contrast on the dark header is > 4.5:1 (use pure white or very light grey).
All buttons must have distinct focus rings.
Use 'aria-label' on all icon-only buttons (copy link, share).

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for main text unless it is a very large headline.
Avoid centering text in cards; left-align creates better scanability for lists.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (copy success, payout requested).
All currency inputs must prevent negative numbers.
Mobile Responsiveness: The header banner should shrink to h-[200px] on mobile, and cards should stack vertically.
instructions_to_main_agent: Start by setting up the Router and the Main Layout (Header + Outlet). Then build the 'Dashboard' page first as it contains the core 'SuperProfile' aesthetic (Dark Banner + Offset Cards). Use the provided image URLs for the 'Course Marketplace' thumbnails.
